Executables, existing model/runtime/source/preparation/teacher and historical artifacts remain read-only; no code edit, refreeze or checkout change during the run.

workerSettings.reason: Sole learner preserves accepted containment, resource and controller context for the bounded new fragment run.
workerSettings.tierInterpretation: Dispatch exposes no per-turn tier field; prompt and local preference do not establish an observed running tier.

runCommand: Execute exactly the new stage.json command through the existing guard. Pin stage/profile/freeze/assignment/command/source/input/model/policy/raw/proof/output/guard receipts and actual exits. No direct or uncontained model launch.
preflight: Verify supplied never/danger-full-access, clean assigned branch/HEAD and exact protocol/assignment/acceptance bytes. Reuse existing stager disk/copy/profile checks and accepted guard; no separate donor/runtime/weights inventory campaign. Native preflight must retain original config, fast-tokenizer byte vocabulary/decoder transport, generated-only callback prefixes, EOS/final-text agreement and input-token bound without truncation.

resourceBounds.recording: Report Job commitment and RSS separately, CUDA allocated/reserved/minimum free, host/setup/guard/child/cleanup, model section and per-request generation times. Preserve initialization-only CUDA reset; no inferred speedup or host configuration change.

inferencePolicy: Pinned original Qwen base, no adapter, unchanged seed17/greedy/fp16/SDPA/settings. Keep both requests, all four/three fragments, order, provenance and neutral IDs unchanged. Use accepted fragment prompt/byte grammar with existing single generate. Optional subset/empty choices remain possible. Preserve raw outputs before validation/projection. No forced selections, repair, fence stripping, cap closing, fallback, partial acceptance, retry or second policy.
guardAcceptance: Require complete immutable profile/output/guard and protected supervisor acceptance, child success, Job closure, ACL/profile/session cleanup and accepted artifact hashes before quality comparison. fragment-completion.json is worker_complete_awaiting_guard/supervisorAccepted=false; completion.json and accepted receipt remain authoritative. Never write accepted outputs after acceptance. Retain actual technical/transport/resource/cleanup failure and stop without rerun or expectation access.

hostComparison.timing: Only after authoritative complete output/guard/cleanup acceptance, pin and read host expectations once for one host-only comparison. Never include them in stage, code, input, prompt, grammar or profile. Technical failure leaves expectations unread.
hostComparison.metrics: Report raw structural validity, whole-response acceptance, actual chosen IDs and candidate denominators separately. Against host sets report each request expected/selected counts, exact-set match, true positives, false positives and misses. Precision is TP/selected (null if zero); recall is TP/expected (null for an empty expected set). Include unsupported-request selections as false positives in aggregate precision, and report correct context-limited empty retrieval separately. Rejected whole responses receive zero exact/retrieval credit, zero accepted true positives and full expected misses; do not score partial parses or fallback. Keep response usability and all two requests visible alongside any valid-output metric.
hostComparison.controllerContributions: JSON/schema, complete context identity, current distinct candidate IDs and unchanged fragment projection are deterministic controls. They do not establish learned relevance. Empty means no_support_in_supplied_context, never factual absence in the whole original/property. This retrieval route produces no generated claim or canonical association.
hostComparison.hostOnlyOutput: One new immutable directory under E:/BhuAayam-data/task-data/ml-distillation/student/fragment-baseline-v1-host-<unique>. Retain failed report attempts; repair only a report lookup without repeating the model phase.

developmentCriteria.resourcesAndCleanup: All original bounds, native transport and authoritative completion must pass.
developmentCriteria.qualification: One development family only; no generalization, conflict completeness, association, source extraction accuracy, official operational qualification, adapter gain or release pass. Actual baseline errors inform the next bounded adaptation decision; no fit/evaluation/promotion is authorized by this run.

exclusions: No reconstruction/original edits, teacher feedback/development disclosure, held-out or retired corpora, acquisition/installations, code/policy/model sweeps, shared API/gateway/catalogue/frontend/dependencies, staging/main/other checkouts, provider calls, credentials/host changes, services/Docker/socket/volumes, push/deploy/promotion.
return: Commit only the two assigned evidence files after execution/comparison; return exact commit, actual metrics/commands/exits and pins, limitations, clean checkout and owned-resource cleanup. Send one completion/material-blocker callback to coordinator 01a0fbd1-c2aa-75c0-8a52-4c4f662f3759, then stop.
